brief: Modest early-1900s one-and-a-half-storey frame cottage, gable end to the street: clapboard walls, a full-width hip-roofed front porch on turned posts behind a white picket fence, and a small rear kitchen; shade trees crowd the front.

facade.notes: a 1905 workers' house in Middletown OH (a steel-mill town): 1.5-storey frame, a full porch, under big maples; a white picket fence along the sidewalk with a gate, wire fencing at the side yard, a neighbour's garage and a back-yard clothesline

why.note: a mill-town lot: a small frame house on a 30-40 ft lot
a picket fence and gate at the walk: the working family's front yard
